newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska feedlot cattle market slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska feedlot cattle market slow - USDA.

text.p: Trade rather slow on Friday, USDA said. Steers and heifers were not fully established on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights).
Dressed Basis Steers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1350 lbs 117.00- 118.00; few with higher percentage of Select and lower dressing percentage, 116.00.
Dressed Basis Heifers - Few Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 117.00- 118.00; few with higher percentage of Select and lower dressing percentage, 116.00.
Prices on slaughter steers and heifers not established. Buyer and seller interest rather light.
Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink.

Slaughter Steers - No confirmed sales. Slaughter Heifers - Few mostly Select, few Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 72.00. Confirmed - 1,400 Last Week - 100 Last Year - 2,100 Wk To Date - None. Sm Pd Lst Wk - None. Sm Pd Lst Yr - None.
